doc.brief: The sizing method the column uses to determine its width.
doc.md:
The sizing method the column uses to determine its width.  Please note
that %GTK_TREE_VIEW_COLUMN_AUTOSIZE are inefficient for large views, and
can make columns appear choppy.

autosize.brief: Columns resize to be the optimal size every time the model changes.
autosize.md: Columns resize to be the optimal size every time the model changes.

fixed.brief: Columns are a fixed numbers of pixels wide.
fixed.md: Columns are a fixed numbers of pixels wide.

grow_only.brief: Columns only get bigger in reaction to changes in the model
grow_only.md: Columns only get bigger in reaction to changes in the model
